title: Product agent loops and LLM features

questions.text: What is the root cause (5 whys)? Can the loop fix it with a tool or a context fact instead of a new guard, judge, retry or wait layer?
Does any output get cut? Where does the agent learn what is left and how to get it?
Is any decision I am adding closed (finite labels and a fallback)? If not, the agent decides, not a classifier.
Is every numeric budget (tokens, turns, caps) derived from the current model or resource, with a measurement behind it?
For each action: requested? reversible? outward? sensitive? Does it ask only when needed, with undo otherwise?
Can the agent verify its own result and act later through a mechanism with an id, not a promise?

Can the agent do, through its tools, everything the user can do by hand for this feature (connect, install, re-check, reschedule, fall back when a source fails)? Does each tool's description say when to use it?
Which output-shape metrics must hold (length, rich-format rate, language, tool use), and are they re-measured on a replay set after any model, provider or prompt change?
Which inputs are untrusted? Does any context hold private data, untrusted content and an external send together?
Who uses the budget, how is it shared, and what happens with a burst of 10 messages?
Which held-out cases will show this generalises, and which metric and effect size decide it? Would every line make sense for a user in another industry and language?

budgets.measure: model calls per turn on a fixed replay set, before and after
golden set of trivial prompts: zero tool calls, p95 latency
trace scan: completion/commitment phrases without a tool call or job id

rules.title: List cut with .slice(0, N) in a file that never reports what is left
rules.why: The agent never learns item N+1 exists and answers from a partial list.
rules.confirm: failing-test: input above the cap; output is neither complete nor {returned, total, nextCursor}
rules.fixHint: page with a cursor and say how much is left

rules.title: Compaction/context threshold written as a literal token count
rules.why: A number tuned for an older, smaller model compacts far too early on today's window.
rules.confirm: measurement: long replays at two thresholds; success and compactions per session
rules.fixHint: a measured fraction of the model's context window read at runtime

rules.title: New judge/guard/verify/retry/wait wrapper around the main loop with no ablation
rules.why: Each layer adds latency and cost and hides the root cause.
rules.confirm: measurement: replay with and without the layer; no win beyond A/A noise

rules.title: Classifier output feeding a free-text slot, or a threshold with no calibration data
rules.why: Open decisions squeezed into labels fail on everything outside them.
rules.confirm: measurement: golden set accuracy and calibration report

rules.title: Untrusted content (web, mail, documents, tool output) concatenated into the instruction slot
rules.confirm: failing-test: canary instruction in a document triggers a tool call

rules.title: Reply says done or 'I will ...' with no tool call or scheduled job in the trace
rules.why: The user trusts a promise nothing will keep.
rules.confirm: failing-test: scheduler tool removed; the reply still promises

rules.title: Proper nouns or quoted phrases from one user's case inside a generic prompt
rules.why: Passes the visible case, fails everyone else.
rules.confirm: measurement: n-gram overlap between fixtures and the prompt; held-out delta

rules.title: New tool exposes less than the system under it (fixed formats, hardcoded options, no retry or re-check)
rules.why: The agent cannot do what the user asks even though the system can, so it improvises or asks the user.
rules.confirm: repro-script: a request the underlying API supports that the tool cannot express

rules.title: Model, provider or prompt changed with no replay of the regression set
rules.why: Output shape (format, length, tool use) silently regresses on the new model.
rules.confirm: measurement: replay set on the old and the new model; a tracked output metric drops beyond the A/A noise

rules.title: Model reply used without checking for empty content or the stop reason; a canned fallback stored as the answer
rules.why: Provider quirks (empty text after tools or thinking) become stored apologies or blank answers.
rules.confirm: failing-test: the provider mock returns empty content; the stored reply is empty or a canned sentence instead of a retry or a visible error

verify.text: the original failing case fails on the base commit and passes on the change
regression and held-out sets: delta with an effect size and interval, not one run
remove each new layer or limit and re-run; keep it only if removal hurts
property tests: completeness or pagination; effect matrix -> ask/do; untrusted never an instruction
claim audit on replay traces: every completion or commitment has a receipt
